title: Fanny B Probable NDE 3711
content: It was the third day after I have my womb cut. It was during the night. I was suffering a lot, it was hurting so much and I was worrying so much about my young kids at home. After a long, long strangling (can't tell the time), I started to feel my body was weighing very light, so light and finally comfortable, and then not the same as most people say that their soul comes out from their head. I felt my soul (I don't know what word I can use for this) just rising up from my body, horizontally, or from the belly, something like that. Then, it's just like most people's feeling, so peaceful, so grateful and my body or my soul had no weight at all. I was in the middle of nowhere, I could see all around me in the same time, 360 degrees. The whole room was lit by a kind of light bright but not hurting, there was no corner, no shadow, and the light seems to be peace, happiness and so on. Then I saw, or I felt because I can't tell if I saw with my eyes or with my soul, I heard with my ears or with my soul. The nurse who took care of me came in for the daily check. She talked to me. I thought I answered but she seemed not to hear. After the daily check, she then ran to fetch the nurse chief of the night, and then the doctor. They worried a lot though I tried to tell them I was fine, I never had been so fine. It seemed no one heard. They gave me medication. I can't tell how long after, all a sudden I felt my soul fall down heavily into my body and all the suffering came back at the same time. It was so strange; in the same moment, the nurse complained that I frightened them and so on. I couldn't say a word. I was so confused. I never heard about NDEs at that time. Unluckily on the next day, no nurse, no doctor was willing to answer my questions. It took time for me to make my husband understand it was not a dream nor because of the medication. It was almost twenty years ago. I remember it as if it's yesterday. And my life change a lot ever since then, I think my person changed. I am a believer but can't tell what religion and I don't think it's necessary to have one.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Felt her soul rise horizontally/from the belly area; perceived the whole room and events during a nurse check.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described body/soul as having 'no weight at all' and feeling 'finally comfortable'.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being 'in the middle of nowhere' while the room was fully lit; 'no corner, no shadow' and the light felt like peace/happiness.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred the third day after her womb was cut (post-operative period), during the night, with severe suffering/pain.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Said she is 'a believer' but cannot tell what religion and doesn't think it's necessary to have one.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: 360-degree perception; attempted to communicate with nurse/doctor but was not heard; sudden heavy fall back into body with pain returning.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with bright peaceful light in the room; observed/attempted communication with medical staff; then involuntary rapid return to body without tunnel, beings, or boundary.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Soul separation felt horizontal/from the belly rather than from the head; described being 'in the middle of nowhere' while also perceiving the hospital room fully lit with no shadows.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was in the middle of nowhere, I could see all around me in the same time, 360 degrees.”; “The whole room was lit by a kind of light bright but not hurting, there was no corner, no shadow…”; “all a sudden I felt my soul fall down heavily into my body and all the suffering came back at the same time.”
